supabaseKey.title: Supabase Service Role Key
supabaseKey.description: Supabase service role key with read access to classification_audits.

githubToken.title: GitHub Personal Access Token
githubToken.description: GitHub PAT with repo read/write access to create branches and PRs.

githubOwner.title: GitHub Repository Owner
githubOwner.description: GitHub username or org that owns the repository.

disagreementThreshold.title: Disagreement Threshold
disagreementThreshold.description: Disagreement rate (0-1) above which the agent will draft a prompt fix. Default: 0.20.
